title: Multilingual seed command is not rerunnable
reasoning: The command uses `get_or_create` only for Church, then unconditionally creates the Fast, Day, DevotionalSet, videos, devotionals, article, recipe, and announcement on every run. Running a seed command repeatedly is a common development workflow; this implementation either duplicates all sample content or may fail if any model has uniqueness constraints around these fields. That can corrupt local/dev fixture state and make tests or demos inconsistent after repeated seeding.
recommendation: Make the command idempotent by deleting/replacing its own known fixture records, using stable natural keys with `update_or_create`, or documenting and enforcing a clear-before-seed workflow.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests exercise running the command twice or assert stable object counts after seeding.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a test that invokes `seed_multilingual_data` twice and asserts there is still one Great Lent fast, one target day/devotional set, one English and one Armenian devotional, and one of each learning resource/announcement fixture.
minimumFixScope: Change `seed_multilingual_data.py` object creation to an idempotent create/update strategy for all records it owns.
